record.title: Dominican Republic COVID land-passenger restriction with limited Dajabón market reopening
record.scope: Dominican side of Haiti land frontier; endpoint limited to Dajabón–Ouanaminthe
record.direction: Dominican admission restricted; Haitian return departures excepted.
record.movement: Ordinary passenger movement and border-market attendance.
record.exceptions: Goods and Haitian nationals returning to Haiti were permitted; November pilot admitted limited market participants.
record.enforcement: National order, later health-minister confirmation and supervised market pilot.
record.relationship: Separate imposing-side regime from R6-AM-002; shared frontier, not two independently closed border dyads.
record.status_observation: Evidence dated in cited sources; no assumption of present status.
record.context: National pandemic measure; Haiti’s separate June permission did not reopen the Dominican side.
record.uncertainty: Formal start is precise; all-post implementation and final national ending are unverified. November endpoint concerns actual local market access, not general reopening.

historical.duration_note: No supported continuous operational interval for the stated scope. Initial fifteen-day term was not an observed expiry; local November partial restoration is not a national duration endpoint.
